bridge.note: Italian makes recency a prepositional phrase (di recente); Spanish routes it through its time-machine verb hacer (hace poco) — the same hace that tells you how long ago anything happened. That hace is Spanish's ordinary way of measuring distance into the past, doing the work a preposition does in English.

interference.es_to_it: 'Di reciente' is not Spanish — recency runs through hacer: hace poco, where hace does the work a preposition would do in English.
interference.it_to_es: 'Fa poco' alone is not the Italian marker; di recente or poco fa.
